title: Slovakian Pudding
description: A traditional Slovakian dessert made with a silky pudding topped with a sweet fruit compote.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine 250ml of Slovakian cream, 100g of sugar, and 4 egg yolks.
Whisk the mixture and cook over medium heat until it thickens.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Stir in 100g of fresh frais and mix well.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until chilled.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional frais if desired.
Optional: Serve with a side of whipped cream or a sprinkle of sugar.
